parsed.rationale: Both `SoundCloudService.fetchMetadata` (SoundCloudService.swift:50) and `YouTubeMusicService.fetchMetadata` (YouTubeMusicService.swift:64) live in the same `MusicShareKit` package and exhibit a high structural similarity (Jaccard 0.808), indicating near-duplicate implementations of the same conceptual operation across two distinct music-service types. Introducing a `MusicMetadataFetchable` protocol with a `fetchMetadata` requirement in the `MusicShareKit` package would unify the contract, allow a shared default implementation where the logic truly overlaps, and make it straightforward to add future services (e.g., SpotifyService) without repeating the pattern. Neither record carries any test, codegen, mock, or sample-app flag, so this is production code where the duplication is actionable.
